## Change

Describe the problem and resulting behavior. Link an issue or minimal reproduction.

## Validation

List the commands actually run and their results. State what was not checked.
For behavior changes, include a regression that fails before the fix.

## Compatibility and documentation

- [ ] Public API follows Dart conventions; unknown wire fields remain intact.
- [ ] Affected examples, docs, changelog, and migration notes are updated.
- [ ] Generated docs pass `dart run tool/docs.dart check`.
- [ ] Upstream mappings/type fixtures are updated where applicable; no gap is hidden.

For an upstream baseline update, provide the old/candidate immutable SHAs, npm
versions, changed exports/cases, official test results, and remaining adaptations.
Follow `doc/maintainers/upstream-updates.md`. For other changes, mark this section
not applicable rather than invent evidence.

## AI assistance

Describe material AI assistance and how the contributor reviewed and verified it.

## Limits

Record unimplemented behavior, host requirements, or follow-up work. Keep reports
and fixtures free of credentials and private application data.
